description: Main CLI entry point for the 'swabble' application, handling command dispatching and subcommands.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Asynchronous function to initialize and run the CLI program, returning an exit code.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches commands based on the first argument, handling 'swabble' or throwing an error.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Handles subcommands under 'swabble', dispatching to specific handlers.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of 'swabble' subcommand handlers.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a subcommand from the command path at a specified index.
